caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical interior wall scene with a central pair of tall, rounded double doors made of dark wood, each door having ornate panels and frosted glass in an elongated oval shape. The doors are flanked on both sides by identical decorative elements: on either side of the doors, there is a large, ornate metallic vase in silver and gold standing on a matching pedestal, with foliage or decorative leaves and flowers extending upward from the vases. The wall behind these objects is covered with a patterned, rose-pink and gold damask wallpaper. Above each vase, hanging on the wall by a gold cord and tassel, is an oval-framed painting of a bouquet of colorful flowers, predominantly red, yellow, pink, and orange, with a green leafy background. The composition is framed at the far left and right by vertical architectural molding details, and the wallpaper continues up to the top edge, finished with a thin horizontal border.
title: Entrance Door
